name: multi-currency-field
title: Multi-currency field
description: An amount and its currency in one field: search the menu, and the decimals follow the currency, reported as whole minor units so a yen is never in hundredths.
docs: value and onValueChange speak { minor, currency }: minor is a whole number in the minor units of the currency (1250 is 12.50 EUR and 1,250 JPY), or null while the field is empty, and the second argument says whether there is an amount that is allowed. The decimals of every currency are asked of Intl (JPY none, EUR two, KWD three), the amount is written the locale's way when the field is left, and either decimal sign is understood when typing (12,5, 12.5, 1.250,00 and 1,250.00). Changing the currency keeps the typed number, works out the minor value again (12.50 EUR is 13 JPY) and announces the result, rounding included; if the number no longer fits min and max in the new currency, that is said at once and not only when the field is left. min and max are minor units, a number for every currency or an object with one per code, and a refusal names the limit in the chosen currency. allowNegative accepts a minus and asks a phone for the full keyboard, because a number pad has none. currencies lists the ISO codes of the menu (one code shows no menu), labels renames every message and screen reader phrase, and name adds a hidden input with the minor units plus <name>-currency with the code. Pass id for a label's htmlFor; it lands on the amount. With no id, aria-label or aria-labelledby the amount is named Amount, so it is never unnamed.
